questions.question: How do fans serve as key stakeholders in sports management? Ans. Effective management must prioritize fan experience and satisfaction to maintain and grow support.

questions.question: Explain the function of FIFA in global sports Ans. FIFA (Fédération Internationale de Football Association) is the global governing body for soccer (football). FIFA also works with member associations to grow the sport and increase its reach across all continents.
